viewerHint: You are a viewer · read-only · ask the project owner for edit access

editor.label: Episode screenplay
editor.hint: Write or paste scenes, action and dialogue. Leaving the editor attempts a save; use Save or Ctrl/Command+S to confirm it explicitly.
editor.emptyHint: This screenplay is empty. Start typing, or upload a .docx, .pdf, .txt or .md file from the top right.
editor.readOnlyDescription: The saved screenplay remains available to read. Ask the project owner for edit access to change it.

promptCreate: Create an episode above, or paste screenplay text and press Save to create Episode 1.
promptPaste: Write or paste this episode's screenplay, then save it to the project.

placeholder.withEpisode:
Type the script for Episode {ep}…

Scene outlines, full dialogue scripts and scene descriptions are accepted as plain text.
placeholder.withoutEpisode: Type the script for Episode 1. Saving creates the episode first.

next.title: Open characters, locations and props
next.description: This only opens Script Breakdown. It does not start analysis, create a generation job or incur a charge.
next.label: Next: script breakdown

blocked.episode: Create or select an episode first.
blocked.saving: The screenplay is still saving. Continue when it finishes.
blocked.saveFailed: The current draft has not reached the project. Retry saving before continuing.
blocked.unsaved: Save the latest changes before opening script breakdown.

workflow.title: From screenplay to production
workflow.summary: Save the current episode before moving downstream.
workflow.step1: Write or paste this episode, then save it to the project. Each episode has its own draft.
workflow.step2: Open Script Breakdown to review characters, locations and props. Opening it does not run analysis.
workflow.step3: Continue to Storyboard when the screenplay and subjects are ready.
workflow.step4: Voice and Delivery remain later production stages; this page does not start either one.
workflow.footerPrefix: Shared aspect ratio and style settings live on

errors.createEpisodeNoId: Episode creation failed because the server returned no episode ID.

states.loadingDescription: Reading episodes, screenplay content and edit access.
states.loadErrorTitle: The screenplay could not be loaded
states.loadErrorDescription: No data was changed. Retry loading the project content.
states.accessErrorTitle: Edit access could not be checked
states.accessErrorDescription: The access service is unavailable. Kuiper will not treat that as a permission denial.
states.refreshErrorDescription: Project refresh failed. The last successfully loaded screenplay remains available.
states.saveErrorDescription: The current draft remains on screen. Retry the same save when ready.
states.offlineDescription: The current draft remains on screen and was not sent. Reconnect, then retry saving.
states.networkTitle: The project could not be reached
states.networkDescription: The current draft remains on screen. Check the connection and retry the same save.
states.createUnknownTitle: Episode 1 creation is not yet confirmed
states.createUnknownDescription: The connection ended while creating the episode. Sending it again could create a duplicate. The draft is preserved; check the episode list before saving again.
states.sessionDescription: The current draft remains on screen. Sign in again if needed, then recheck the session before saving.
states.accessChangedDescription: The current draft remains on screen but was not saved. Confirm edit access with the project owner before retrying.
states.draftPreserved: No server-confirmed text was replaced. This browser still holds the current draft until the page is closed or reloaded.
states.permissionDescription: This account cannot view the project. No content was changed.

import.triggerHint: Accepted: DOCX, text-layer PDF, TXT, MD · up to 10 MB
import.limits: Deterministic parsing supports up to 200 episodes. Each title is limited to 191 characters and each screenplay to 65,535 UTF-8 bytes (about 64 KB). It does not call AI and has no AI generation cost.
import.summarySingle: No episode markers detected · {count} characters will become one episode
import.languageTitle: This file contains multiple scripts. Choose one to keep.
import.languageHint: Other language passages are removed. Scene headings and bilingual titles remain when detected.
import.moreEpisodes: {count} more episodes are hidden from the preview; all will be imported.
import.singleModeTitle: No episode table or episode headings were found.
import.singleModeDescription: The complete extracted text will be imported as one episode. No AI splitting runs here.
import.strategyLabel: How should these episodes be applied?
import.appendDescription: Keep all {count} current episodes and append this import.
import.replaceDescription: Permanently replace {count} current episodes with this import.

errors.extract: The file could not be read.
errors.outcomeUnknown: The connection ended before the import result was confirmed. Direct resend is blocked to prevent duplicate episodes. Refresh and review the project episodes first; this preview and its strategy remain open.
errors.fileTooLarge: Choose a file no larger than 10 MB.
errors.pdfNoText: This PDF has no text layer. Run OCR or upload a text-based PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD file.
errors.unsupported: Choose a DOCX, PDF, TXT or MD file.
errors.macro: Macro-enabled DOCM files are not accepted. Save a DOCX copy first.
errors.tooManyEpisodes: This file contains more than 200 episodes. Split it into smaller files before importing.
errors.episodeNameTooLong: Episode {number} has a title longer than 191 characters. Shorten it before importing.
errors.episodeTextTooLarge: Episode {number} exceeds 65,535 UTF-8 bytes (about 64 KB). Split it into smaller episodes before importing.

episodes.deleteLast: At least one episode must remain.
episodes.errorAdd: The episode could not be created.
episodes.errorAddOutcomeUnknown: The connection ended before episode creation was confirmed. Adding again is blocked to prevent a duplicate. Refresh the episode list first.
episodes.errorRename: The episode could not be renamed.
episodes.errorDelete: The episode could not be deleted.
